why_agent_cannot: an email confirmation link must be opened by the human
what_human_must_do: Check that you're allowed. The terms exclude the United States, China, Singapore, Canada, the United Kingdom and sanctioned countries, and say: "You must not use VPNs, proxies, or other tools to circumvent geographic or jurisdictional restrictions."
Open app.txflow.com , sign in and enter the code.
Deposit USDC. The docs say: "Deposits below 5 USDC are not supported on our platform and cannot be credited."

Trade perpetual futures, and keep some trading going every week if you want points. Warning At high leverage a small move can liquidate you. The docs say that in a full liquidation "all of the margin backing that position is consumed", and none of it comes back.
Check your points dashboard each Tuesday.
costs: Perpetuals at the base tier cost 0.015% for maker orders and 0.045% for taker orders, and funding is paid every 1, 4 or 8 hours depending on the market. Withdrawals cost 1 USDC through the official Arbitrum bridge. New users can earn $50 in fee credits by depositing $500 net, trading on three days and reaching $30,000 of taker volume within seven days. Those credits are "limited to eligible users
risks: You must be at least 18. No identity check is described for trading. TxFlow can change "its rules, scoring, pool sizes and schedule", and its terms let it freeze your access "at any time, for any reason". Only the deposit bridge has a published audit.
